available.definition: The resource is present and may be exposed for the requested use without a material scientific limitation.
available.display_rule: Serve normally; still include provenance and dataset version.

available_with_warnings.definition: The resource is present and may be exposed for the requested use, but documented limitations must travel with every response.
available_with_warnings.display_rule: Serve with visible warnings and limitations.

restricted.definition: The resource is present but the requested use is limited by a scientific or quality constraint; it is not approved for unrestricted quantitative use.
restricted.display_rule: Serve only with an explicit restriction notice and the approved use scope. Do not present the resource as comparison-ready.

blocked.definition: The requested use is prohibited because a hard scientific or integrity constraint applies, even if some data bytes exist.
blocked.display_rule: Do not serve the resource for this use; explain why.

metadata_only.definition: No measurement data are available for the resource; only metadata, provenance, or source references can be served.
metadata_only.display_rule: Serve metadata and provenance only; do not render empty charts as data.

use_definitions.quantitative_comparison: Any numeric comparison, aggregation, ranking, or derived statistic across rows, runs, or investigations.
use_definitions.time_series: Plotting or querying an ordered time axis within a run.
use_definitions.provenance: Inspecting source file, row, checksum, and retrieval metadata.

datasets.display_name: PSI-10 ACME Flame Design gas-flame tests

reasons.message: One row per test summary; there is no within-test time series.
Quantitative use is approved only through explicit comparability rules.
69 PSI-10 rows carry RAMP, RAMPED, or LOW O2 qualifiers in numeric columns; they are not fixed set points.
20 PSI-10 rows have blank final oxygen and pressure fields; missing is not zero.
Tad (K) and Zst are computed by the source, not measured.
120 PSI-10 inverse rows have no fuel label.
The selected source is an experimental summary table, not a telemetry series.

restrictions: Do not aggregate ramped rows as fixed conditions.
Do not treat Tad or Zst as measured temperatures or mixture fractions.
Do not compare with PSI-159 fuel labels without an explicit chemistry mapping.

datasets.display_name: PSI-159 ACME CFI-G cool-flame and ignition tests

reasons.message: One row per test summary; there is no within-test time series.
Quantitative use is approved only through explicit comparability rules.
The TFP Yes/No field is not expanded by the source; its meaning remains undefined.
The Xf field is not expanded by the source and is treated only as labeled.
Blank cool-flame flags mean missing, not 'no'.
Flame type and hot ignition contain case variants that require normalization before grouping.
Dashes in peak burner temperature, extinction mode, and color are source sentinels, not zeros or categories.
Four rows contain spreadsheet errors in computed or measured columns.
The selected source is an experimental summary table, not a telemetry series.

restrictions: Do not interpret TFP until a source document defines it.
Do not treat blank cool-flame flags as 'no'.
Do not merge Celsius and Kelvin peak burner columns.
Do not use Tad or Zst as measured values.

reasons.message: Exports and workbook sheets are separate runs and are never concatenated.
No calibration source is present for the raw sensor channels.
Five telemetry exports or workbook sheets are separate runs; do not concatenate them.
613,008 telemetry points are flagged uncalibrated.
1,072,783 telemetry points have no stated unit.
574,733 telemetry points are flagged constant.
RelativeSeconds is milliseconds despite the name; the Saffire timestamp is not reconciled with Cygnus time.
Radiometer, anemometer, fan tachometer, smoke-wire, and igniter raw channels have no calibration document.
Chart-only PSI-100 sheets are not parsed.

restrictions: Do not treat uncalibrated raw signals as physical measurements.
Do not use the Saffire timestamp as a primary time axis.
Do not compare channels across exports without an explicit time-basis check.

Do not treat -999 as a concentration.
Do not join material names without a validated key.
